search_document: ## Travel
search_document: - For overnight flights, Mira prefers an aisle seat away from the lavatory.
search_document: - During Berlin visits, Mira stays at the Lindenhof Hotel near the east station.
search_document: - The luggage service booking reference is 48392017.
search_document: ## Project Atlas
search_document: - The Atlas migration owner is Devon Chen; questions about the cutover go to Devon.
search_document: - Atlas production cutover is scheduled for 2026-11-08 at 02:00 UTC.
search_document: - Atlas staging listens on TCP port 7419.
search_document: ## Finance
search_document: - Invoices from Northstar Hosting map to account 6210 for the synthetic Acorn account.
search_document: - Blue Finch Studio invoices are due forty-five days after their issue date.
search_document: - The bookkeeping export code for Blue Finch Studio is BF-029184.
search_document: ## Accessibility
search_document: - Sam needs captions enabled for every remote meeting because speech alone is difficult to follow.
search_document: - Sam prefers reduced motion and no autoplaying animations in the dashboard.
search_document: - Use the high-contrast interface theme for Sam during screen sharing.
search_document: ## Incident response
search_document: - For a stalled Oriole import, pause its scheduler before retrying the failed batch once.
search_document: - If the Oriole import fails twice, escalate to the data platform on-call instead of retrying again.
search_document: - The synthetic Oriole outage incident number is 90715264.
search_document: ## Food preferences
search_document: - Priya is vegan and does not eat honey.
search_document: - Priya drinks decaffeinated coffee after noon.
search_document: - Priya is allergic to cashews.
search_document: ## Release process
search_document: - The Juniper release checklist requires a canary deployment followed by a fifteen-minute error-rate check.
search_document: - Taylor is responsible for approving Juniper production releases.
search_document: - The synthetic Juniper rollback reference is release-2037-amber.
search_document: ## Support routing
search_document: - A customer unable to export their records gets priority two unless data is being lost.
search_document: - The North team covers support from 07:00 to 15:00 UTC on weekdays.
search_document: - Support queue ticket 58273016 belongs to the North team.
